messages:
mira: Quick round on the preflight/network step. I tightened the copy and added a compact error card + a 'Download diagnostic bundle' CTA in the mock: https://www.figma.com/file/newmock/onprem-preflight-compact2. Can we look for keyboard/focus regressions and SR wording?
jamal: Loaded it. Nice and lean. Two issues: focus sometimes lands on the small action after results update because we swap nodes. Use stable keys and hide/show instead.
sophia: For screen readers keep an offscreen live region (role=\"status\" aria-live=\"polite\") and avoid moving focus unless it's a blocking failure. Keep announce strings short: e.g., \"Network check failed: egress-ssh\".
alex: Implementation tip: toggle data-state attributes and animate opacity to avoid layout shifts. For 504/timeouts show targeted suggestions rather than \"try again later\". Example: \"Gateway timed out — try the quick check or download diagnostics.\"
riley: Copy nits: change primary CTA to \"Start network check\"; rename small action \"Fix\" -> \"Open troubleshooting guide\"; change transient fallback copy to a 2-line action list. Add a small tooltip \"Why this matters\" explaining egress ports.
jamal: CSS: reserve min-width on status chips to avoid width jumps and respect prefers-reduced-motion to disable pulses. I'll add a patch.
sophia: I'll run NVDA + VoiceOver keyboard-only passes tomorrow and post any regressions. Watch for contrast on the amber chip (might need darker tone).
alex: I'll add a probe-error map for common HTTP codes (504 -> quick-check suggestion, timeout -> diagnostics link). Also keep the download button focusable during bundle generation.
mira: Action items: jamal stable keys + min-width chips; alex map 504/timeouts to suggested actions and stream download state; sophia a11y pass; riley update Figma copy and tooltip; I'll consolidate copy changes after tests. Thanks all :thumbsup:
preview-bot: preview-bot: preview for branch preflight-compact-2 is live: https://preview.redwood.com/branches/preflight-compact-2 — please smoke test keyboard + SR flows.
